def: a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (i.e. mishap)

occurrences.text: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
